GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 130 (25 Jan 46) ESS/FI
(SCAPIN-652)
APO 500
25 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
Subject : Incomplete Foreign Exchange Transactions.
1. Reference is made to C. L. O. Memorandum No. 989 (2. 1) dated 10 December 1945 and No. 1090 (2. 1) dated 14 December 1945, subject: “Payment of Incomplete Foreign Exchange Transactions,” and Memoranda for the Imperial Japanese Government, file AG 130 (22 Sept 45) ESS, subject: “Control of Financial Transactions,” and file AG 130 (19 Nov 45) ESS/FI, subject: “Payment on Incomplete Foreign Exchange Transactions.”
2. The Imperial Japanese Government may permit payment of remittances or collections expressed in Japanese yen when the notice of remittance or collection was received by the paying institution in Japan prior to 23 September 1945 provided that:
a. It is payable to the Imperial Japanese Government, or
b. It is payable to several persons none of whom receive more than 1,000 yen.
3. Remittances or collections referred to in par. 2 above which were made in Korea will continue subject to instructions set forth in Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, AG 122. 2 (6 Dec 45) ESS/FI, subject: “Proceeds of Remittances and Collections Since 15 August 1945.”
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.Allen
Colonel,A.G.D.
Asst Adjutant General
